text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 100, "unit": "problems", "kind": "count", "span": "100 math problems to complete in total"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 12, "unit": "problems", "kind": "count", "span": "completes 12 problems on Monday night"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3 times as many problems as he did on Monday"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "one-quarter of the remaining math problems (denominator)"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "Tuesday = 12 * 3 = 36"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "remaining after Monday = 100 - 12 = 88"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "s1"], "out": "s3", "note": "remaining after Tuesday = 88 - 36 = 52"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s3", "q4"], "out": "s4", "note": "Wednesday = one-quarter of 52 = 13"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "remaining after Wednesday = 52 - 13 = 39"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of math problems Chris has left to complete on Thursday"}, "dismissed": []}
